messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for SERVICE: inference-runtime (High error rate)

pagerduty-bot: 
- Incident: PD-4821
- Trigger: 5xx rate > 10% (1m) for /v1/generate
- Affected: eu-west-1-gpupool, fallback nodes
- Urgency: high

Jay: I'm on-call. acking in PD. investigating now.

Mia: pinging from #incidents — any visible customer impact yet? a Prod alert dashboard shows spike in 5xx and latency.

Jay: Initial quick check: NLB 502 spikes, many requests timing out on the inference workers. No deploys in the last 30m according to deploy-bot.

Tina: @Jay please follow the inference runbook: check worker OOMs, queue length, and recent model rollouts. If it's capacity, scale pool and enable fallback route.

Jay: running logs tail on one problematic host:
```
2026-03-14T09:02:11Z worker[grpc]: ERROR: upstream read failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = KV cache OOM
2026-03-14T09:02:12Z supervisor: restarting worker pid=1123
2026-03-14T09:02:12Z gateway: 502 GET /v1/generate  latency=1203ms
```

Arjun: saw similar OOM traces earlier on cpu-fallback VMs. Looks like KV cache blowout after a spike in long-context requests. Could be a customer job sending extremely long sequences.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4821 acknowledged by Jay (oncall).

Jay: mitigation step 1: throttling long-context requests via temporary routing rule. Applying rate limit (5 rps per token-heavy session) now.

deploy-bot: No config rollouts in progress. Applying temporary route rule: `route.inference.fallback.limit=5rps`

Mia: Thanks — can you also open a quick trace for a sampled request id so we can see token lengths? If there's a runaway client we should block it.

Jay: grabbing a sample id: req=01H8KZQ9Y2X0W1A2B3C4; token_count=18k(!) — looks like a badly-behaved internal job.

Tina: If it's internal, assign to the owning team. But first we need stabilization. Can you scale up eu-west-1 GPU pool by +2 nodes? That should reduce OOMs while we isolate the client.

Jay: scaling request submitted to autoscale group: +2 g4dn nodes. Estimated ready ~90s. Also evicting largest KV caches on affected workers.

Arjun: evict command queued: `redis-kv flush-prefix session:ext-*` (targeted). Doing cache eviction now.

Jay: cache eviction in progress. Monitoring error rate.

(20s later)

Jay: error rate down from 12% -> 3.4% after eviction and rate limit. Latency still elevated but trending down.

Mia: customer impact update: support dashboard shows ~14 customer requests affected in the last 10m; we should notify SEs if this persists.

Tina: Good short-term. Next: identify offending client, block or throttle at edge, and prepare a post-incident follow-up. Jay — can you continue as primary and hand off to Arjun for deeper forensics in 20m?

Jay: Yep. I'll stay on until autoscale finishes and error rate stabilizes under 1%. After that I'll hand off to Arjun for log/trace aggregation and to craft the RCA timeline.

Arjun: I'll pick this up at ~09:15 UTC. What state should I expect? anything special to grab?

Jay: expect: a) sampled request ids (including 01H8KZQ9Y2X0W1A2B3C4), b) worker core dumps from pids 1123/1140, c) KV cache metrics. I'll paste links in this thread.

(autoscale event)

deploy-bot: autoscaler: added 2 nodes to eu-west-1-gpupool (ready).

Jay: autoscale completed. error rate now 0.6%. Latency ~420ms  p50.

Mia: marking customer-impact: partial; severity reduced. Notifying support to watch tickets.

Tina: nice work. Jay — once error rate < 0.5% for 10m, hand off officially to Arjun. Put a short summary in the PD incident and include mitigation steps and next actions.

Jay: will do. adding short PD note: "Mitigated via targeted KV eviction, temporary rate-limit for long-context sessions, and +2 GPU nodes. Root suspected runaway internal job — under investigation."

Arjun: taking ownership for postmortem and forensic collection. I'll collect traces, identify client origin, and propose a durable limit on token length and/or improved KV protection.

Jay: handing off now — last observed error rate 0.4%. Thanks everyone.

Tina: assigning PD-4821 to Arjun for RCA. Please follow the incident template and tag infra/security if the client is internal.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident PD-4821 status updated: mitigated -> in-progress (RCA). Owner: Arjun.

Mia: adding a quick note for support: "Temporary disruption to inference in eu-west-1 for ~12 minutes, partial customer impact — internal job likely root cause. Support to monitor tickets and escalate if customers report regressions."

Arjun: copying notes. I'll post a draft RCA in #postmortems once I have logs correlated. Closing this channel thread for live mitigation; follow-up discussion will be in PD incident and postmortem doc.

Jay: thanks — back to standby. :thumbsup:

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: Jay, :eyes: Tina, :white_check_mark: Arjun)
